profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-based public company whose own site describes it as presenting its philosophy, vision, and strategy, along with corporate information, shareholder and investor relations material, its business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information. The site names Masayoshi Son as representative director, chairman, and president and chief executive officer. The company was founded in 1981 and trades under the ticker SFTBF.

The site frames the company's outlook around what it calls the era of the AI revolution, describing its thinking about that period, the efforts of group companies, and the possibilities AI may bring. Beyond that framing, the harvested site text does not describe specific AI products or services.

Company records also list a SEC Central Index Key of 0001065521 for SoftBank Group. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
